text:
alyssa: Quick heads-up — docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 needs review + approval before tomorrow's release cutoff. It's the SDK snippet + migration guide for v1.12; the docs-preview is failing because one of the example links is 404. Can reviewers prioritize? cutoff: 2026-03-22 09:00 PST. Assigned reviewers: @matt, @sophie, @jordan.

sophie: on it. what's the exact failure?

ci-bot: docs-preview build #678 failed — Markdown link resolver error: 'examples/sdk_auth.md' not found in branch 'release/v1.12-docs' (see logs: https://ci.internal/678).

matt: I can take a pass in ~2h. assign to me pls.

jordan: to confirm — if this doesn't merge before 09:00 PST tomorrow we gate the feature-flag rollout and it will be delayed to next patch, right @tina?

tina: correct. we have a hard cutoff for FF rollout at 09:00. merging after that won't make today's canary release.

alyssa: thanks — pushing a quick fix for the bad link now. small change: replace `/examples/sdk_auth.md` with `/sdk/authentication.md` in the snippet.

alyssa: ```markdown
See authentication examples at /sdk/authentication.md
```

docs-bot: preview redeploy triggered by @alyssa on branch release/v1.12-docs — build queued.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #679 started.

matt: looked through the migration section — one nit: in the Python snippet rename `client` -> `redwood_client` to match style guide. otherwise LGTM.

sophie: approved. also verified the snippet links render in the rendered page locally.

alyssa: made the rename and pushed. thanks @matt. PTAL @jordan.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #679 passed — preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.12-docs/3421

jordan: approved. +1 from me.

alyssa: merging now. note: I'll hold the merge until 07:30 PST to keep a buffer for any last-minute CI flakiness. If anything unexpected, I'll revert.

tina: sounds good. if merge completes by 08:30 PST we'll include it in the canary roll tomorrow.

matt: noted, will jump on any followups.

alyssa: thanks all :tada:
